name: Code World Model for Simultaneous-Move Markets

mentions.name: Code World Model for Simultaneous-Move Markets
mentions.description: A code world model for simultaneous-move settings such as capital markets and order-book markets. It extends DeepMind's CWM approach with a simultaneous-move MCTS variant (decoupled UCB per player) so training approximates a Nash equilibrium instead of converging to an exploitable pure strategy. Unlike learned neural world models such as JEPA, it keeps a deterministic, inspectable code-based simulator, providing better auditability and easier RL-like training.
mentions.problem: Standard MCTS/IS-MCTS used in code world models assumes a single active player at each node, which fails in simultaneous-move settings like Orbit Wars or order-book markets, converging to an exploitable pure strategy rather than a Nash equilibrium; learned neural world models like JEPA lack determinism, speed, and debuggability.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Code World Models in Simultaneous Move settings like Capital Markets. DeepMind's CWM approach relies on standard MCTS/IS-MCTS, which assumes a single active player at each node.

This doesn't work in simultaneous-move settings like Orbit Wars (or order-book markets), converging to an exploitable pure strategy rather than a Nash equilibrium.
